verdict.rationale: Superset documents an agent-status surface: running agents appear inline on the workspace item, and you get notified when an agent finishes or pauses for input. Agents run in terminals inside each workspace, and a single dashboard monitors many concurrent sessions, so you can watch their live output. A power user corroborates tracking 40-50 simultaneous sessions without losing track, and another praises the background service that keeps terminals alive. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on real-time activity streaming beyond the terminal view, and detail on status states other than running, finished and waiting for input.
